title: Derived lower shriek of module objects for a compactification
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring ([sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]), let
$f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and let
$c=(X\xrightarrow{i}\bar X\xrightarrow{g}Y)$ be a compactification of $f$
([sk-def-nagata-sketch-data]). For $T=X,\bar X,Y$, let $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$
be the pulled-back coefficient ring ([sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]) and
$\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$ its category of module objects in abelian sheaves on
$T_{\mathrm{proét}}$ ([sk-def-sfb-module-objects]). Write $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$
for the unbounded derived category ([sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]).

The *derived lower shriek attached to $c$* is the composite
$$
Rf^c_!:=Rg_*\circ D(i_!)\colon
D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})\xrightarrow{D(i_!)}D(\Mod_{\Lambda_{\bar X}})
\xrightarrow{Rg_*}D(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y}).
$$
Here $i_!\colon\Mod_{\Lambda_X}\to\Mod_{\Lambda_{\bar X}}$ is the exact additive
extension by zero of [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]; $D(i_!)$ is its induced
functor on derived categories, obtained by applying $i_!$ levelwise
([sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]); and $Rg_*$ is the total right derived
pushforward of module objects ([sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]). Thus the
construction first applies $D(i_!)$ and then $Rg_*$; it does not define $Rf^c_!$
by applying the right-derived-functor construction to the underived composite
$g_*\circ i_!$.

split_report.summary: Audited the layer-B definition against the current blueprint and upstream module-object source.
